judgment.notes: N001 is instantiated with g and its real mean-zero Fourier truncations, all in the same H^gamma ball; their L2 norms sum to at most 2R. N011 therefore applies to every smooth truncation with its common C0,tau0. N006 supplies the Sobolev isometries and H^1 product bound used term by term in D009-D010; Dinv on general L2 inputs is justified by removing the zero mode (BG002). The scalar mean term is justified by BG003. There are no E/M applications.
